nodes.description: Public mapping address => uint256 tracking token balances of each account.
Public token name string 'EGYPT_WINS'.
Public token symbol string 'EGYWII'.
Public uint8 number of decimals (18).
Public uint256 total supply of tokens minted at construction.
Public nested mapping owner => spender => uint256 of approved spending amounts.
Public function (not a real constructor) that assigns the whole totalSupply to msg.sender and emits a Transfer event; callable by anyone at any time.
Public transfer(address to, uint256 value): checks sender balance, mutates balances and emits Transfer.
Public approve(address spender, uint256 value): writes allowance[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
Public transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value): checks balance and allowance, mutates balances and allowance, emits Transfer.
Caller-controlled address used as balance owner, allowance owner and spender in all state mutations.
Unprotected state write balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply inside SimpleERC20Token, letting any caller mint the whole supply to themselves.
Balance decrement balanceOf[msg.sender] -= value in transfer.
Balance increment balanceOf[to] += value in transfer.
Allowance decrement allowance[from][msg.sender] -= value in transferFrom.
Allowance write allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value in approve.
Balance decrement balanceOf[from] -= value in transferFrom.
Balance increment balanceOf[to] += value in transferFrom.
Parameter 'to' (address) of transfer, recipient of the credited balance.
Parameter 'value' (uint256) of transfer, amount deducted and credited.
Parameter 'spender' (address) of approve, key of the allowance mapping.
Parameter 'value' (uint256) of approve, approved spending amount.
Parameter 'from' (address) of transferFrom, owner whose balance and allowance are spent.
Parameter 'to' (address) of transferFrom, recipient of the credited balance.
Parameter 'value' (uint256) of transferFrom, amount moved between accounts.
Named return variable 'success' of transfer, always returned as true.
Named return variable 'success' of approve, always returned as true.
Named return variable 'success' of transferFrom, always returned as true.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used inside SimpleERC20Token to receive the full totalSupply, so any caller can obtain the supply.
totalSupply is read and written into balanceOf[msg.sender] by the unsafe assignment.
msg.sender determines which account receives the minted totalSupply in the unprotected initialization write.
SimpleERC20Token executes the unrestricted supply assignment without any ownership check.
msg.sender identifies the source balance checked and debited in transfer.
transfer executes the unchecked balance decrement balanceOf[msg.sender] -= value.
transfer executes the unchecked balance increment balanceOf[to] += value.
value parameter flows into the unchecked subtraction of the sender balance.
value parameter flows into the unchecked addition to the recipient balance.
to parameter selects the storage slot credited by the balance increment.
msg.sender selects the source account of the unchecked balance subtraction.
balanceOf storage mapping is read and written by the sender balance decrement.
balanceOf storage mapping is written by the recipient balance increment.
msg.sender is the owner key when writing the allowance in approve.
approve executes the allowance assignment.
spender parameter selects the allowance sub-key written in approve.
value parameter is stored as the approved allowance amount.
msg.sender selects the allowance owner slot written in approve.
allowance storage mapping is written by the approve assignment.
transferFrom executes the unchecked balance decrement balanceOf[from] -= value.
transferFrom executes the unchecked balance increment balanceOf[to] += value.
transferFrom executes the unchecked allowance decrement allowance[from][msg.sender] -= value.
from parameter selects the account debited in transferFrom.
from parameter is the outer key of the allowance slot decremented in transferFrom.
to parameter selects the storage slot credited in transferFrom.
value parameter flows into the unchecked subtraction of the from balance.
value parameter flows into the unchecked addition to the recipient balance.
value parameter flows into the unchecked subtraction of the allowance.
msg.sender is the inner allowance key checked and decremented in transferFrom.
balanceOf storage mapping is read and written by the from balance decrement.
balanceOf storage mapping is written by the recipient balance increment.
allowance storage mapping is read and written by the allowance decrement.
transfer always assigns true to its named return variable success.
approve always assigns true to its named return variable success.
transferFrom always assigns true to its named return variable success.

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient address parameter only serves to key the balanceOf increment inside transfer and should be merged into that function node.
The amount parameter is only consumed by the sender decrement and recipient increment of transfer, so it should be merged into the function node.
The spender address is only used to select the allowance sub-key written by approve and can be merged into that function node.
The amount parameter is only stored into the allowance mapping by approve and should be merged into the function node.
The from address only keys the balanceOf and allowance decrements performed by transferFrom and can be merged into that function node.
The to address only keys the balanceOf increment performed by transferFrom and should be merged into that function node.
The amount parameter only feeds the balance and allowance mutations of transferFrom and can be merged into that function node.
The named return variable success is a constant true produced entirely by transfer and should be merged into that function node.
The named return variable success is a constant true produced entirely by approve and should be merged into that function node.
The named return variable success is a constant true produced entirely by transferFrom and should be merged into that function node.
